ننص (form I)

# نُنَصُّ (nunaṣṣu) /nu.nasˤ.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of نَصَّ (naṣṣa)
# نَنُصَّ (nanuṣṣa) /na.nusˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of نَصَّ (naṣṣa)
# نُنَصَّ (nunaṣṣa) /nu.nasˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunct
